Now that you've browsed the options, select a visualization and apply it to your panel.

To apply a visualization, complete the following steps:

1. In the display options sidebar, click a visualization type from either the **Suggested** or **All** section. For example, click **Stat** to see your data as a single big number, or **Gauge** to see it as a radial meter.
2. Watch the visualization preview at the top of the panel editor update immediately to show your data in the new format.
3. Try clicking a few different visualizations to compare how they display the same data.
4. When you've chosen one, click **Save dashboard** in the top-right corner, then click **Save**.
Your panel now displays your data using the visualization you selected. You can change the visualization at any time by reopening the panel editor.
